vanished first, then a SessionEnd with an earlier ts: the SessionEnd wins

ended, then listed live by claude agents
ended, then a newer prompt

filing.name: a new session joins the single active subject of its project
with two active subjects in its project, a new session stays unfiled
a to_resume subject takes no new session
the never-filed project names never file
a clear successor follows the normal rule
a resume of a known id keeps its subject
a session first seen in claude agents is filed at creation
a later session's excerpts clear the older one's in its subject
a non-interactive run filed at first sight neither counts nor clears excerpts
an unlisted session's end shows it was driven and clears the older excerpts

confirm.name: create from the selected sessions takes their project and files them
create from no session, an unknown one or two projects is refused
create in a known project; an unknown project is refused
rename keeps names unique ignoring case among open subjects
a name is refused empty, too long or with a hidden character
filing into an archived subject is refused until it is reopened
filing an ended session leaves a to_resume subject; a live one makes it active
merge moves the sessions, archives the source with merged_into and wakes the target
unfile one or several sessions; none or an unknown one is refused
archive with the routine box clears the excerpts; archiving again is refused
reopen sets to_resume and stamps the latest confirmation; only an archived subject, never a merged one
to_resume subject, session listed live
archived subject, newer prompt
auto-archived subject, background done then working
a subject row confirmed finished archives it with the routine box, clears its excerpts and keeps one expiring copy
a to_resume verdict sets the status and keeps the excerpts; the same row twice in a batch is confirmed once
a changed proposal, a missing subject, a row gone and a refused filing write nothing
an unfiled row is filed under the proposed subject or a new one, then decided
filed under a subject a later session or a live one decides, the verdict waits for the subject's own row
an empty subject's row archives it with no session and no input

the model answers where the default would, unsure included

a subject with several ended sessions, a cleared one among them, needs one verdict

triage.name: a latest session that saw no prompt leaves the anchor on the one before
clear then exit anchors the row on the cleared session

a clear successor left unfiled gives its own row and the subject keeps its row
superseded unfiled sessions, non-interactive runs, sessions without a prompt and live ones give no row
an unfiled session is proposed its project's only open subject, offered several, or none
subject whose only session never prompted
a live session keeps its subject off the list
a session that lived and ended again after its verdict needs a new one
a reopened confirmation does not count

prompt.name: quotes, backslashes, tabs and newlines take JSON's escapes

C0 controls keep JSON's own escapes
plain accented and CJK text is sent as it is
fifteen digits of the nonce are no collision
an excerpt holding the nonce is refused
an excerpt holding the nonce in capitals is refused
a nonce formed across an escape of the data line is refused
